content.text:
I built `/work/index.html`. It renders with no console errors or warnings. I checked two states: the default 14-day view, and a test copy zoomed to 6 hours, where the individual 10-minute readings show as dots joined by a line. I found no missing fields in the CSV, and all 263,088 data rows load.

**How it works**
- **Overview (SVG):** the whole period 2020–2024, as the daily min–max range of `tl` (shaded band) with the daily mean as a line. The axis shows years and months.
- **Detail (Canvas):** one panel for `tl` and, below it on the same time axis, a separate panel for `rr`. When there are more than about 1.5 readings per pixel, it draws each pixel column's min–max (with mean) and the highest `rr` in that column. Further in, it draws the raw readings, with dots and bars once there is enough room per reading. The panel title says which of the two modes is showing.
- **Linking:** dragging in the overview sets the detail period. Zooming or panning in the detail moves the overview selection to match. Double-clicking the detail clears the selection and resets to all five years. Hovering shows the nearest reading.
- **Caption:** every number in it is computed from the data. It reads: July averages 22.7 °C and January 2.6 °C; the average day–night swing is 8.6 °C; the extremes are 36.7 °C on 8 Jul 2021 and −10.1 °C on 10 Jan 2024.

```
REPORT
deliverable: index.html
requirements:
  R1: done - overview of 2020–2024: daily min–max band plus daily mean of tl
  R2: done - canvas detail zooms to a 2 h minimum span, showing individual 10-min readings as dots
  R3: done - overview brush sets the detail period; detail zoom/pan moves the brush back
  R4: done - separate rr bar track below tl on a shared UTC time scale
  R5: done - overview: years + months; detail: multi-scale UTC labels from days down to HH:MM
  R6: done - all 263,088 rows loaded with d3.text/csvParse; aggregation done in the browser
  R7: done - axes labelled °C, mm / 10 min, Time (UTC); title; one-sentence caption computed from data
assumptions:
  - rr at a time stamp is the sum over the 10 minutes ending at that stamp
  - overview aggregated per UTC day (min/max/mean)
  - initial detail period = last 14 days of the record (computed from data)
  - minimum zoom span is 2 hours, which is enough to inspect single readings
limitations:
  - in the dense mode, rr bars show the per-pixel maximum, not the sum
  - at very small spans the overview brush is narrower than a pixel and hard to see
  - empty fields would show as gaps; this file has none
```
